rules.statement: A sale by a Fiscal does not necessarily divest an execution-debtor of all right in the property until the Fiscal's conveyance is registered, and even then, the debtor may still lease, mortgage, or sell the property.
rules.supporting_quote: My opinion is that, as the Fiscal could transfer a debtor's property only if he strictly conformed to the provision of the Ordinance No. 4 of 1867, the purchaser got, because the Fiscal could give, nothing except by written conveyance in the terms laid down in the schedule to the Ordinance.
